latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Movie Maker Free.

- Assemble video clips into finished 1080p MP4 movies with transitions and background music.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Fast cloud processing (1–2 minutes) with 100 free credits for new users.
- Simple upload, edit, and export workflow using cloud APIs—no local installation required.
- Includes error handling, session management, and credits tracking.
- Guides users with concise setup, file type support, and workflow tips.
